narr: An upper level shortwave trough moved over a surface trough and generated thunderstorms. These storms formed in a very moist airmass and some produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. There were a number of streets closed in Uvalde including FM 3447 and FM 2369.
Thunderstorms produced heavy rain of 6.59 inches in four hours that led to flash flooding. RR 187 along the Sabinal River was flooded south of Sabinal.
